facts.business: RBZ Jewellers Limited is an organized manufacturer of jewellery in India with a B2B focus and a growing B2C retail presence through Harit Zaveri Jewellers showrooms in Gujarat.

capacity_or_capex.item: Planned expansion of 4 new showrooms across Gujarat
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Over the next two financial years

guidance_or_targets.statement: Planned expansion of 4 new showrooms across Gujarat over the next two financial years

key_risks: Dependence on bridal and occasion-led jewellery as core strength
Execution risk in expanding into adjacent and higher-frequency purchase categories
Expansion risk related to new showroom rollouts across Gujarat
